caveats: Draws flowcharts and sequence diagrams inline; on Paseo 0.13+ other diagrams render with Mermaid inside the plugin.
On Paseo 0.11 and 0.12, text around a drawn diagram uses the plugin's limited Markdown renderer; from 0.13, Paseo's.
With Better Paseo, turn off its "Plugin markdown for replies" setting, or replies show diagrams as code.
